title: Practice guidelines for renal replacement therapy in patients with acute kidney injury
desc: Renal replacement therapy (RRT) is a life-support modality for patients with acute kidney injury (AKI). However, there is a clear lack of uniform standards for core RRT procedures and initiation. To address this gap, critical care experts have developed practice guidelines with recommendations on key topics including timing for RRT initiation, selection of treatment modality, and therapy discontinuation. These recommendations guide clinicians in RRT for critically ill patients, effectively reducing complications from life-threatening AKI.
